title: Hive Mind Knowledge File Frontmatter
description: Required frontmatter on every `knowledge/**/*.md` file. The Apiary Archivist enforces this on Parliament merges; the Audit mode checks it during health checks.

domain.description: Top-level domain for routing. Typically matches a directory under knowledge/ (e.g. `ground-segment`, `program`, `orbital`).

type.description: File role. `reference` = stable facts. `register` = tables (risks, decisions, stakeholders). `status` = current state, decays fast. `index` = pointers to external systems. `reference-library` = corpus index with retrieval triggers, auto-discovered by the Ask workflow.

description.description: One-line summary of the file's contents. Used by agents to decide whether to load this file.

decay.description: How fast the content goes stale. Determines freshness thresholds in Audit mode (fast=14d, medium=60d, slow=180d).

confidence.description: Agent's confidence that the content is correct. Forces agents to surface uncertainty.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of most recent update.

review_by.description: Optional — date by which a review is expected. Required for `decay: fast` files. Audit flags when exceeded.

sources.description: Optional citation list. Items may be free-form strings or objects with `path`/`url`/`doc`/`type` fields.

classification.description: Classification of the content in this file. Optional by default; required on every knowledge file when the Hive's `hive.yml` sets `classification.marking_required: true`. Must not exceed the Hive's `classification.max_level`. Files above UNCLASSIFIED must also carry an in-body banner as the first body line.
